race.comment: BALDONI (1) keeps running the same sort of races each time. He is coming back in trip for this. At least you know he will run this out. TOP LINER (9) gets a fair way back in her races. She is bred to be enjoying this distance range. Has to lift here. SHUWAIB (4) did enough at his first outing to say he has some ability in there. Kicking off at the mile indicates they think he's a stayer too. VADAR (6) does need to show more improvement but is bred to want every bit of this.
